name: system_time
description: Get the current system time, convert between timezones, list available timezones, and perform timezone-aware time calculations. All operations are local and do not require network access.

operation.description: One of: current_time | convert_timezone | list_timezones | system_info. Defaults to current_time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo', 'UTC'). Defaults to local timezone.

target_timezone.description: Target IANA timezone for conversion (e.g., 'Asia/Tokyo'). Required for convert_timezone.

source_timezone.description: Source IANA timezone (defaults to local timezone).

source_time.description: Source time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T14:30:00'). Defaults to current time.

author: Stella
